[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Sexy Combat Idols is a complete combat overhaul. [/color][/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=3]Its 1.6 compatible and has i18n files support and are designed for gaming on a SteamDeck. [/size][/color]

[color=#ffff00][size=3]How it works?[/size][/color]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The combat Idols are your weapons like sword or dagger. You play and when you get your hands on a Combat Card click "K" for Card Archiv and select the card and then "I need you" --> now a sword will appear on your hotbar and like you would select it like normal sword you select the slot and the Idol will appear! And jeah there are normal Attacks/ LeftClick or X on Controller and Ultimates / Right Click or A on XBox Controller/SteamDeck. [/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]You can have the complete first hotbar full of combat cards! Every Combat Card gets exp! BUT only the one who does the killing gets 100% exp and the others like 20%.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]There is also a friendship System / mentoring system , so the cards can learn from each other when they become friends! [/size][/color]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It is an addon to my previous MAIN mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41536]Sexy Market Idols[/url]. [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#ff0000][u][i]IMPORTANT: !!! PLEASE READ: [/i][/u][/color][color=#ffff00][u][i]So you NEED Sexy Market Idols to play Sexy Combat Idols BUT if you don't want the Market System... You just download and activate ONLY the Combat Card Packs not the original Cards or other Content Card Packs from SMI. And ingame you just don t put down a Idol statue! --------> [/i][/u][/color][/size][color=#fce5cd][size=4][u][i]So you can enjoy Sexy Combat Idols without Sexy Market Idols[/i][/u][/size][/color][color=#fce5cd][size=4].[/size][/color][color=#fce5cd][size=4] [/size][/color]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If you want both, it just works fine! ;)[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Download ALL requirements (SexyMarketIdols, GMCM, APF-Animated Portrait Framework, SMAPI, Content Patcher)[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Download this mod SexyCombatIdols[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Download at[/color][color=#ffff00][u][i] LEAST ONE Combat Card pack[/i][/u][/color][color=#D4D4D8], if not no cards will appear! (I play with all Combat Card Packs)[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]4. Download the [/color][color=#ffff00][u][i]Yandere and Dancer Pack if you want to play with these new classes as well[/i][/u][/color][color=#D4D4D8] ( i did implemented them later thats why they are seperated)[/color][/size]

[i][u][b][color=#ffff00]Copy all the folder into your Stardew Valley Mod folder or install via Nexus Mod Manager.[/color][/b][/u][/i]

[color=#ffff00][font=Comic Sans MS]How to evolve:[/font][/color]

[font=Comic Sans MS]After reaching Affinity level 10/10 with a Stage 1 Card AND Max Level you can evolve the card! Which means its getting a rebirth and starts now at level 1 but with a increased level Stat roll! [/font]

[color=#ffff00][font=Comic Sans MS]Tags and personalites:[/font][/color]
[font=Comic Sans MS]- ALL Cards are random! They get Random Tags (Except Common Cards), Random Personalities, each of them have unique mechanics! The Vampiric TAG for example drains HP for the farmer with hits. [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]The Clumsy personality give you disadvantage in almost every Stat! BUT you get a 10% chance to hit twice![/font]

[color=#ffff00][font=Comic Sans MS]Level UP System:[/font][/color]

[font=Comic Sans MS]I really like fire emblem games so i decided to make a LIVE leveling system ! There is a level UP roll for example for a common card you get maximum of 3 Points each level (Its higher for higher rarity cards) ! And these point are going randomly into ATK, ATKSPEED, HP or Defense. the Percentage of ATK and so on depends on the Classes ! For example a Brawler put the point 50% into ATK and HP and DEFENSE 10% in Speed! [/font]

[font=Comic Sans MS]back to leveling! If a common card get a level up it then a random roll how good the level up is! so it can be poor 1/3 points or good 2/3 points or perfect 3/3 ! [/font]

[color=#ffff00][font=Comic Sans MS]Affinity System:[/font][/color]

[color=#ffffff][font=Comic Sans MS]you can click "Y" while your sweet Idol is equiped and spawnt to open the IDOL CHAT! here you can Chat, compliment look at her stats and her background. Fighting with your idol gives your affinity and not only unlocks the background but also give some new stats percenage. Sooo jeah talk to your IDOL.....[/font][/color]

[color=#ffff00][font=Comic Sans MS]Friendship/ Mentoring System:[/font][/color]

[color=#ffffff][font=Comic Sans MS]All is random --> level up random, Card reveal random.... So i thought give back some control ... So the Friendship Systems comes to work.... If you equip 2 idols right side to side to another for a HOLE day ( no you can not just sleep) you got to be ask if they should be friends! If you say yes! it gives tons of advantages... For example Bond level 1 the idols can learn from each other For example a brawler with HIGH ATK cann mentoring a Priestes with LOW ATK ! And the Priest can mentoring speed or HP ! and so on! An there is even a tag team bonus... but see for yourself! [/font][/color]

[color=#ffff00][font=Comic Sans MS]Star System:[/font][/color]

[color=#ffffff][font=Comic Sans MS]So lets say you have to much Cards and you want to get rid of them ... You can (poor girls) you get a little bit of gold AND more importanly a STAR CHARD! with this you can upgrade each card to another Starlevel for example a common card has 3 Star slot! each slot give s 4% stat growth ! [/font][/color]

[color=#ffff00][font=Comic Sans MS]Sexy Adventures:[/font][/color]

[font=Comic Sans MS]If you decided to keep your precious cards.. THEN you can send them to a sexy Adventures. With the button "Q" you open the sexy adventures HUB.... Here you can send your cards on a expedition! They can level, they loot... what more do you want? [/font]

[color=#ffff00]GMCM / Difficulity Settings[/color]

I HIGHLY recommend installing GMCM if you not have it...
In the GMCM Menu you can change the difficulty to your liking there are 4 presets, but you can always just change the sliders if you want! Just don t forget to save! 

[i](I personally play with a spawn multiplier 4 BUT be aware there are monster spawning outsite the map tiles! I m currently investigating the issue but its really difficult to solve! )[/i]

ALL HOTKEYS are toggable and can be changed in the GMCM menu!
